# Endpoint reference

<!-- Generated by tools/openapi-check/check.mjs --write-reference from the merged OpenAPI document. Do not edit by hand. -->

Every endpoint of API v1, generated from the merged OpenAPI document (which the validator keeps identical to the
[API contract](../spec/API.md)). A running server serves the full interactive reference with request/response
schemas and examples at `/api/docs` (Swagger UI) and the raw document at `/api/openapi.json`.

Scope legend: `public` = no authentication, `auth` = any signed-in user or token, `admin` = admin role (tokens also
need the `admin` scope), anything else is the personal-access-token scope required. **qt** = the endpoint also accepts
`?access_token=` (streaming and feeds).

187 operations in 16 groups.

## Server

Health check and the API description itself (OpenAPI document and Swagger UI).

| Method | Path | Scope | Summary |
|---|---|---|---|
| GET | `/api/docs` | `public` | Swagger UI |
| GET | `/api/openapi.json` | `public` | OpenAPI document |
| GET | `/api/v1/health` | `public` | Health check |

## Setup

First-run claim of a fresh server using the one-time setup token printed on first start.

| Method | Path | Scope | Summary |
|---|---|---|---|
| POST | `/api/v1/setup` | `public` | Create the first administrator |
| GET | `/api/v1/setup/status` | `public` | First-run status |

## Uploads

Resumable uploads using the tus 1.0.0 protocol (extensions: creation, termination, checksum, expiration). Use these for anything large.

| Method | Path | Scope | Summary |
|---|---|---|---|
| GET | `/api/v1/uploads` | `files:write` | List my incomplete uploads |
| POST | `/api/v1/uploads/` | `files:write` | Create a resumable upload |
| OPTIONS | `/api/v1/uploads/` | `public` | tus capabilities |
| DELETE | `/api/v1/uploads/{id}` | `files:write` | Cancel an upload |
| HEAD | `/api/v1/uploads/{id}` | `files:write` | Get upload offset (resume) |
| PATCH | `/api/v1/uploads/{id}` | `files:write` | Upload a chunk |

## Trash

Trashed files: list, restore, delete permanently, empty. Trash is purged automatically after `files.trash_retention_days`.

| Method | Path | Scope | Summary |
|---|---|---|---|
| GET | `/api/v1/trash` | `files:read` | List my trash |
| DELETE | `/api/v1/trash` | `files:write` | Empty my trash |
| DELETE | `/api/v1/trash/{id}` | `files:write` | Delete permanently |
| POST | `/api/v1/trash/{id}/restore` | `files:write` | Restore from trash |

## Vault

End-to-end-encrypted password vault. The server only stores ciphertext (`v1.<nonce>.<ciphertext>`) and KDF parameters; see the Vault cryptography documentation.

|---|---|---|---|
| GET | `/api/v1/vault` | `vault:read` | Vault key material |

| DELETE | `/api/v1/vault/folders/{id}` | `vault:write` | Delete a folder |
| POST | `/api/v1/vault/init` | `vault:write` | Initialise the vault |

| PUT | `/api/v1/vault/items/{id}` | `vault:write` | Update an item |
| DELETE | `/api/v1/vault/items/{id}` | `vault:write` | Delete an item |
| PUT | `/api/v1/vault/key` | `vault:write` | Change the master password |

| POST | `/api/v1/vault/rekey` | `vault:write` | Rotate the vault key |
